book.name: 2 Korin
book.title: Lama narain babam la omirong Paulo me mai ekelesiap onim Korin

content: Are ratmat ga tuburio ra ties na dalap tuo gare ro: Tala kan tula Korin ga teiam dalap mi ga giginam ba kabuat.
Memani, mimit la puoming meba tokosarming ga teraba. Pa mimi kan la tale puoming meba makosarming dalap tuo ga teraba. Memani, turuo la tiiam dalap mi ga giginam.

Are ratmat ga tale tula mi tinan. Memani, na agat tung, leba tala mi ga magimarang kiribasiap mim, eba giginam ba dalap tuo me milam. Are ratmat ga lake omirtung urio babam me miun gare rie ga agattung eba tala mii tubiat ga agimarang tavuk ming le goirala ga teraba aime. Eva, tira tara la temeba dalap tuo, mimi gat la mionama maset ga temiba.

Migat, tara la omirtung babam me miun, mitara kadiktung ga dalap tuo la miavio giginanim ula kakanu migat, ga toiop gat nulibap. Pa tale omirtung urio babam meba talang giginanim miun. Karuk. Omirtung meba mira gare ro, “Mitara narung me milam ga tualam dalap tuo kan maset miun”.
Maulo Paulo meba miavaiang tavuk ang migana la okosarong kiribas

Tie, leba migana ba la ualo giginanim maun noba, tale ualo giginanim toun. Karuk. Makosarong dalap ma non mi ga giginam kirat. Pa miptang, tale kan tiestung ga tugama mikosarong mimir ganam ga giginam dalap mi. Memani, tale kan tuga talang giginanim aun migana la akosarong tavuk ila kire.
Apugutmiara irio migana kabirana mi ga masingmiala papot ma inamaniap a man tavuk ila kire la okosarong. Atabo urie la puoieng ira a.
Are ratmat ga temaieng le miavaiang kirinim ang ga maidangming dalap a. Ebun noba giginanim ula kakanu la aduieng migat irio migana.
Are ratmat ga mimariktung. Ina alagiming ga asingmiala la na ming migat aime.
Omirtung urio babam me miun. Memani, tuga tameram dalap mi eba omiuluo ties tung ga makosarming mirier pagap o karuk.
Miptang, leba miavaiang kiribas ang migana ba me irie tavuk la okosarong, tie turuo gat la eba tavaiang. Leba paga ba isik la tuavaia, tiestung gare ro na bonim a Karisito eba miagaralie.
Akosartung gare tiruo, memani ebun burana Satan ga bukiraraang. Abit ara man tavuk la ume akosar Satan.
Unama Paulo Troas ga namo aptam tiesiap ba aime Taitas
Tie, tara la bettung na taun Troas meba ovaiktang bais ula mumuru ang Karisito, unavo Ila Kakani alang tung meba okosartang urio ubi.

Pa dalap tuo la tale maiot teiliat. Karuk. Memani, ekelesia papa ruang Taitas la tale toulo mi, are ratmat ga tale muo togimaong togo Troas ga kadiktung migat me nunamap ming. Are ratmat ga marulai ekelesiap papap tuam onim Troas ga tula bettung na provins Masedonia.
Pava gare kukuf ula mamaguieng ang Karisito

Pa titot tivo temaieng me aun Morowa. Memani, mirier taraiap la ume pauala tapmat meba makurupeling mirier danunumiap ga pagap mila kiram. Eva, panum tapmat meba baispang o bais ula muru ang Karisito na mirier napup ganam ga are kukuf ula mamaguieng la betieng ga iavio ifif me na mirier napup.

Migat ara, pava la kapana gare bonat la ime ialo kukuf ula muru la uaro Karisito ga ualo kamniap aun Morowa. Urio kukuf la ime ila kabirana ma inamaniap la naganmeng ira Karisito ga maionama na alang me na panbinim. Ga ime ila gat kabirana ma inamaniap la tale naganmeng ga maionama na alang me na iou gat.

Me irie gar la unama na alang me na iou, urio kukuf la are kukuf o nuvarap, memani tale mepto bais pang. Pa irio gar la unama na alang me na panbinim pava la are kukuf ieng ninimiap, memani omela bais pang. Pa aga la puoong migat meba okosarang urio ubi? Karuk a noba, pa pavat.

Pava la tale kapana gare papot ma teip o usingnuala o kakarabunim la mela tapmat ga maiaramo ties ang Morowa meba meranam kakepup maiam non inamaniap. Pa paro kan urio ubi na kilalap a Morowa kan. Are ratmat ga na irap a Morowa ga Karisito, pame mavaik migat tiesiap la ualam paun.
